statement.type:
∀ (d : ℕ),
  0 < d →
    ∀ (S : SemantEqRef.MassActionSourceReduced.System d),
      SemantEqRef.MassActionSourceReduced.AdmissibleSystem S →
        ∀ (C : SemantEqRef.MassActionSourceReduced.CompatibilityClass d),
          SemantEqRef.MassActionSourceReduced.ClassOf S C →
            ∀ (x0 : SemantEqRef.MassActionSourceReduced.State d),
              SemantEqRef.MassActionSourceReduced.PositiveState x0 →
                SemantEqRef.MassActionSourceReduced.InClass C x0 →
                  ∃ ε,

                      (∃ x, SemantEqRef.MassActionSourceReduced.IsGlobalForwardSolution S x0 x) ∧
                        ∀ (x : ℝ → SemantEqRef.MassActionSourceReduced.State d),
                          SemantEqRef.MassActionSourceReduced.IsGlobalForwardSolution S x0 x →
                            ∀ (t : ℝ), 0 ≤ t → SemantEqRef.MassActionSourceReduced.BoxBound ε (x t)
